English: Using the World Health Organization Assessments Instrument for Mental Health Systems (WHO-AIMS) as a guideline for the interview, all KII questions were structured to identify the extent of mental health integration in primary health care services.

Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce asibitocin guda 2 da suka yi bincike a Nairobi, Kenya, suna da ƙarancin kuɗaɗe da kuma ƙwararrun ma’aikata don kula da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, kuma ba su da ɗakuna masu zaman kansu domin tabbatar da sirrinta mara lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dikliniki tše 2 tšeo ba di lekodišišitšego ka Nairobi, Kenya, di be di na le thušo ya ditšhelete ye nnyane le bašomi ba mmalwa bao ba hlahlilwego ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo a menagano, ebile di hloka le diphapoši tša sephiring go betefatša gore balwetši ba ba le sephiri.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በኬንያ ናይሮቢ ውስጥ የዳሰሷቸው 2 ክሊኒኮች አናሳ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እና ለአእምሮ ጤና ጥበቃ የሰለጠኑ ጥቂት ሠራተኞች እንደነበራቸው እና የታካሚውን ሚስጥራዊነት ለማስጠበቅ የግል ክፍሎች እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል።

English: For patients, this lack of service often means living with mental health conditions that have negative effects on their daily lives.
Luganda: Eri abalwadde, ebbula ly’empeereza lino litera okuba nga litegeeza okubeera n’endwadde z’obwongo ezikosa embeera yaabwe eya bulijjo.
Yoruba: Fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́, àìní àwọn ìṣe yìí já sí pé wọ́n máa gbé pẹ̀lú àwọn àrùn ọpọlọ tó ní ipa tí kò dára ní ọjọ́ ayé wọn.
Zulu: Ezigulini, lokhu kuntuleka kwenkonzo ngokuvamile kusho ukuphila nezimo zempilo yengqondo ezinemiphumela engemihle ezimpilweni zazo zansuku zonke.
Hausa: Ga marasa lafiya, wannan rashin ayyuka yana nufin rayuwa tare da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa wanda yake da mummunan tasiri a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum.
Northern Sotho: Go balwetši, tlhokego ye ya tirelo gantši e ra gore batho ba tla phela ka malwetši a maphelo a menagano ao a nago le diabe tša go se loke maphelong a bona a ka mehla.
Amharic: ለታካሚዎች ይህ የአገልግሎት እጦት ማለት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በእለት ተእለት ህይወታቸው ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ከሚያሳድሩ የአእምሮ ጤና ሁኔታዎች ጋር መኖር ማለት ነው።

English: In many countries, including Kenya, the number of people living with mental health conditions is increasing.
Luganda: Mu mawanga mangi, nga ne Kenya mw’ogitadde, omuwendo gw’abantu abatambula n’endwadde z’obwongo gugenda gweyongera.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀pọ orílẹ̀-èdè, pẹ̀lú Kenya, iye àwọn tó ń gbé pẹ̀lú àìsàn àìlera ọpọlọ ń pọ̀ si ni.
Zulu: Emazweni amaningi, okuhlanganisa ne-Kenya, isibalo sabantu abaphila nezifo zengqondo siyanda.
Hausa: A ƙasashe da yawa, ciki har da Kenya, adadin mutanen da suke fama da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa yana ƙaruwa.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinageng tše ntši, go akaretšwa ka Kenya, palo ya batho bao ba phelago ka malwetši a maphelo a menagano e a oketšega.
Amharic: ኬንያን ጨምሮ በብዙ ሃገራት የአእምሮ ጤና ችግር ያለባቸው ሰዎች ቁጥር እየጨመረ ነው።

English: Unfortunately, medical facilities like clinics and hospitals often don’t have adequate resources to help with these issues.
Luganda: Ebyembi, ebifo ewajjanjabirwa gamba ng’obulwaliro n’amalwaliro amanene bitera obutaba na bikozesebwa bimala okusobola okuyambako ku nsonga zino.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láàánú, àwọn ibùdó ìwòsàn bíi ilé ìwòsàn abẹ́lé àti họsibítù kìí ní àwọn ohun tọ́ nílò láti lè yanjú àwọn nǹkan wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Emazweni amaningi, okuhlanganisa neKenya, inani labantu abaphila nempilo yengqondo Ngeshwa, izikhungo zezokwelapha ezifana nemitholampilo nezibhedlela ngokuvamile azinazo izinsiza ezanele zokusiza kulezi zinkinga.
Hausa: Abin takaici, wuraren kiwon lafiya kamar asibitoci yawanci ba su da isassun kayan aiki domin taimakawa da waɗannan matsaloli.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi, mafelo a tša maphelo a go swana le dikliniki le dipetlele gantši ga a na le methopo ye e lekanego go thuša ka mathata a.
Amharic: እንደ አለመታደል ሆኖ እንደ ክሊኒኮች እና ሆስፒታሎች ያሉ የህክምና ተቋማት ለእነዚህ ጉዳዮች የሚረዱ በቂ ግብዓቶች የሏቸውም።

English: Patients also face other challenges, like a lack of information about mental health, or discrimination for having a mental health condition.
Luganda: Abalwadde era bafuna okusoomoozebwa okulala, gamba ng’ebbula ly’obubaka obukwata ku mbeera y’obwongo, oba okuboolebwa olw’okuba n’endwadde y’obwongo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn náà máa ń dojú kọ àwọn ohun mìíràn, bí i àìní ìròyìn nípa ìlera ọpọlọ, tàbí títanù nítorí níní àìsàn tó jẹ mọ́ ìlera ọpọlọ.
Zulu: Iziguli nazo zibhekana nezinye izinselele, njengokuntuleka kolwazi mayelana nempilo yengqondo, noma ukucwaswa ngokuba nesimo sezempilo yengqondo.
Hausa: Marasa lafiya kuma suna fuskantar wasu ƙalubale, kamar rashin samun bayanai game da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, ko nuna wariya don samun yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši gape ba lebana le ditlhohlo tše dingwe, tša go swana le tlhokego ya tshedimošo ka ga maphelo a menagano, goba kgethologanyo ya ge ba na le malwetši a maphelo a menagano.
Amharic: ታካሚዎች እንደ የአእምሮ ጤና መረጃ እጦት ወይም የአእምሮ ጤና ሁኔታ ስላለባቸው የሚደርስባቸው መድልዎን የመሰሉ ሌሎች ተግዳሮቶች ያጋጥሟቸዋል።

English: As a result, accessing proper care is often difficult, and patients don’t get the specialised care they need.
Luganda: Olw’ensonga eyo, okufuna obujjanjabi obutuufu kutera okukaluba, era abalwadde tebafuna kufiibwako kwa njawulo kwe beetaaga.
Yoruba: Bí i èsì, níní àyè sí ìkẹ́ tó péye ò rọrùn, àti pé àwọn aláìsàn kìí ní àǹfààní sí irú ìtọ́jú tó nílò.
Zulu: Ngenxa yalokho, ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele kuvame ukuba nzima, futhi iziguli azikutholi ukunakekelwa okukhethekile ezikudingayo.
Hausa: A sakamakon haka, samun damar kulawa mai kyau sau da yawa yana da wahala, kuma marasa lafiya ba su samun kulawa ta musamman da suke buƙata.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka la se, go fihlelela tlhokomelo ya maleba gantši go boima, ebile balwetši ga ba hwetše tlhokomelo ye e kgethegilego yeo ba e hlokago.
Amharic: በዚህም ምክንያት ተገቢውን እንክብካቤ ማግኘት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ አስቸጋሪ ነው፤ እናም ታካሚዎች የሚያስፈልጋቸውን ልዩ እንክብካቤ አያገኙም።

English: In this study, the researchers wanted to understand what mental health services are available to patients in Nairobi, and what challenges make it difficult to provide these services.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera empeereza z’embeera y’obwongo eziweebwa abantu mu Nairobi, na kusoomooza ki okuzibuwaza eky’okutuusa empeereza zino eri abantu.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ní òye nípa irú èto ìlera ọpọlọ tó wà fún àwọn aláìsàn ní Nairobi, àti àwọn ìpèníjà tó ń jẹ́ kó ṣòro láti pèse àwọn ìṣe wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo zezempilo yengqondo ezitholakala ezigulini zaseNairobi, futhi yiziphi izinselele ezenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su fahimci waɗanne irin kayayyakin kiwon lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa ne suke samuwa ga marasa lafiya a Nairobi, da kuma irin ƙalubalen da ssuke sa ya zama da wuya a samar da waɗannan ayyuka.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša ke ditirelo dife tša maphelo a menagano tšeo di hwetšwago ke balwetši ka Nairobi, le gore ke ditlhohlo dife tšeo di dirago gore go be boima go fana ka ditirelo tše.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ በናይሮቢ ውስጥ ለታካሚዎች ምን አይነት የአእምሮ ጤና አገልግሎቶች እንደሚገኙ እና ምን ምን ተግዳሮቶች እነዚህን አገልግሎቶች ለማቅረብ አዳጋች እንደሚያደርጉ መረዳት ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They were particularly interested in how to provide better services for vulnerable groups of people, like teenagers.
Luganda: Okusinga ennyo baayagala okulaba engeri esobola okukozesebwa okutuusa empeereza ezisingako eri abantu abali mu bwetaavu, gamba ng’abatiini.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ìfẹ́ pàtàkì sí àti mọ bí a ṣe lè pèse ìse tó dára fún àwọn ọ̀wọ́ ẹni tí wọn ò nípá, bí i àwọn ọ̀dọ́.
Zulu: Babenentshisekelo ikakhulukazi ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezingcono kumaqembu abantu abasengozini, njengentsha.
Hausa: Sun kasance masu sha’awar sanin yadda za a samar da ingantattun ayyuka ga rukunonin mutane masu rauni, kamar matasa.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba tloga ba na le kgahlego mabapi le ka fao ba ka abago ditirelo tše kaone go dhlopha tše di lego kotsing tša batho, tša go swana le bafsa ba mahlalagading.
Amharic: በተለይ እንደ ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ተጋላጭ ለሆኑ ቡድኖች እንዴት የተሻለ አገልግሎት መስጠት እንደሚችሉ የማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራቸው።

English: The researchers said these groups often need extra support, especially if they’re dealing with challenging issues like teen pregnancy.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebibinja by’abantu bano bitera okwetaaga obuyambi obususse ku bwa bulijjo, naddala singa baba bagozoobana n’okusoomooza gamba ng’embuto z’ekivubuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn ọ̀wọ́ wọ̀nyí máa ń nílò ìrànwọ́ tó níla, pàápàá jùlọ tí wọ́n bá ní ìdojúkọ bíi oyún ọ̀dọ́mọdé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi la maqembu avame ukudinga ukwesekwa okwengeziwe, ikakhulukazi uma ebhekene nezinkinga eziyinselele njengokukhulelwa kwentsha.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce waɗannan rukunoni galibi suna buƙatar ƙarin tallafi, musamman idan suna fuskantar matsalolin ƙalubale kamar ciki na matasa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dihlopha tše gantši di hloka thekgo, kudukudu ge ba lebane le ditlhohlo tša go swana le go ima ga bafsa ba mahlalagading.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህ ቡድኖች በተለይም እንደ ታዳጊ እርግዝና ያሉ ፈታኝ ጉዳዮችን እየተጋፈጡ ከሆነ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ተጨማሪ ድጋፍ ያስፈልጋቸዋል ብለዋል።

English: Using guidelines from the World Health Organisation (WHO), the researchers created a questionnaire about mental health services to use in their study.
Luganda: Nga bakozesa enkola okuva mu Kitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi yonna (WHO), abanoonyereza baakola questionnaire etambulira ku mpeereza z’embeera y’obwongo okusobola okugikozesa mu kunoonyereza kwabwe.
Yoruba: Lílo ìlànà láti ọ̀dọ Àjọ tó ń rí sí ọ̀rọ Ìlera Lágbàáyé (WHO), àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sẹ̀dá ìwé aṣèbéèrè nípa ìṣe ìlera ọpọlọ láti lò nínú ìwádìí wọn.
Zulu: Besebenzisa imihlahlandlela ye-World Health Organization (WHO), abacwaningi benze uhlu lwemibuzo mayelana nezinsizakalo zempilo yengqondo abazozisebenzisa ocwaningweni lwabo.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da jagororin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO), masu binciken sun ƙirƙiri wata takarda mai jerin tambayoyi game da ayyukan lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa don amfani da su a cikin bincikensu.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša ditlhahli go tšwa Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase (WHO), banyakišiši ba hlamile lenaneo la dipotšišo ka ga ditirelo tša maphelo a menagano leo ba tlogo le šomiša ka dinyakišišong.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለጥናታቸው ጥቅም ላይ ለማዋል የአለም ጤና ድርጅት (አ.ጤ.ድ) መመሪያዎችን በመጠቀም ስለ አእምሮ ጤና አገልግሎቶች መጠይቅ አዘጋጅተዋል ።

English: They then interviewed 12 medical staff from 2 clinics in Nairobi and investigated the existing services at their clinics.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma baabuuza abeebyobulamu 12 okuva mu bulwaliro 2 mu Nairobi era ne banoonyereza ku mpeereza obulwaliro bwabwe ze bulina.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera 12 láti ilé ìwòsàn abẹ́lé 2 ní Nairobi láti wádìí ìwa àwọn ìṣe ìtọ́jú tó wà láwọn ilé ìwòsàn abẹ́lé náà.
Zulu: Babe sebexoxisana nabasebenzi bezokwelapha abangu-12 abavela emitholampilo emi-2 eNairobi futhi baphenya ngezinsizakalo ezikhona emitholampilo yabo.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka yi hira da ma’aikatan lafiya guda 12 daga asibitoci 2 a Nairobi kuma sun binciki ayyukan da ake yi a asibitocinsu.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba botsološitšeT bašomi ba tša kalafo ba 12 go tšwa dikliniking tše 2 ka Nairobi gomme ba nyakišiša ka ga ditirirelo tšeo di lego gona ka dkliniking tša bona.
Amharic: ከዚያም በናይሮቢ ከሚገኙ 2 ክሊኒኮች ለ12 የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ቃለ መጠይቅ በማድረግ በክሊኒካቸው ውስጥ ያሉትን አገልግሎቶች መርምረዋል።

English: They asked staff how mental health services could be improved at their clinic, and what challenges might stop patients from seeking or receiving proper treatment.
Luganda: Baabuuza abakozi engeri empeereza z’embeera y’obwongo gye zisobola okulongoosebwa mu bulwaliro bwabwe, awamu n’okusoomooza okuyinza okulemesa abalwadde okunoonya oba okufuna obujjanjabi obusaanidde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n bi àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ bí èto ìlera ọpọlọ́ ṣe lè di gbígbèrú ní àwọn ilé ìwòsàn abẹ́lé wọn, àti àwọn ìdojúkọ tó lè kojú àwọn aláìsàn láti dẹ́kun wíwá tàbí gbígba ìtójú tó péye.
Zulu: Babuze abasebenzi ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo yengqondo zingathuthukiswa kanjani emtholampilo wabo, nokuthi yiziphi izinselelo ezingavimba iziguli ekufuneni noma ekutholeni ukwelashwa okufanele.
Hausa: Sun tambayi ma’aikatan yadda za a inganta ayyukan kula da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa a asibitinsu, da kuma irin ƙalubalolin da ka iya hana marasa lafiya neman ko karɓar magani mai kyau.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba botšiša batšomi ka fao ditirelo tša maphelo a menagano di ka kaonafatšwago ka kliniking ya bona, le gore ke ditlhohlo dife tšeo di ka thibelago balwetši go nyaka goba go hwetša kalafo ya maleba.
